name: Primal Company
summary:
Primal Company is an intense multiplayer survival experience set inside a mysterious and hostile research facility. Players must work together to explore dark corridors, complete objectives, and survive while being hunted by a powerful primal entity.
Communication and teamwork are essential — every sound matters, every decision counts. Use your environment to hide, escape, or outsmart the threat as tension builds with each passing moment. No two sessions are the same, and survival is never guaranteed.
